title: Using Inner Class Resource in a Resource does not work
body:
### Tested versions

4.6

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8183) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.84 GiB memory

### Issue description

Sometimes, you want to make complex resources, that are made of an array or dictionary of sub-resources.

The following method does not throw an error in the editor, but when we reload the scene, the resource fails to load.
```gdscript
@tool
class_name UndirectedGraph extends Resource

class RadiusNode extends Resource:
	@export var name:String
	@export var position:Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO
	@export var radius:float = 1.0
	func _to_string():
		return "Node "+name

var selected_nodes:Array[RadiusNode] = []
var root_nodes:Array[RadiusNode]
@export var adjacency_list:Dictionary[RadiusNode, Array] = {}
@export var edge_list:Array[Array] # should be Array[Array[RadiusNode]] but Godot does not support it
var indexed_nodes:Array[RadiusNode]:
	get(): return adjacency_list.keys()
```

When saving the scene, the resource is saved properly. But when loading the saved scene, the resource fails at being loaded properly:
```
  ERROR: Attempted to assign an object into a TypedDictionary.Key, that does not inherit from 'GDScript'.
  ERROR: Unable to convert key from "Object" to "Object".
  ERROR: res://addons/platform_editor/graph_platform_3d/undirected_graph_data.gd:27 - Invalid access to property or key 'position' on a base object of type 'Resource ()'.
  ERROR: res://addons/platform_editor/graph_platform_3d/graph_contour_3d.gd:101 - Trying to assign value of type 'Nil' to a variable of type 'PackedVector3Array'.
...
```

Note: the error at `undirected_graph_data.gd:27 ` and `graph_contour_3d.gd:101` are consequences of the resource not being loaded.

If I moved the `RadiusNode` class in its own file, everything is fine.

### Steps to reproduce

See above.

You can probably use the code above to make a resource, attach it to a node and edit it in the inspector.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I can make one if requested.
